locale.zh-CN: 语言包。不传、传 undefined 或 null 时继承外层 LocaleProvider 的语言，最外层都没有时组件回退 zh_CN；ConfigProvider 的 locale 优先于它。可传内置的 zh_CN、en_US，或至少含 code 的自定义语言包，自定义语言包缺的文案与 currency 回退到 en_US。
locale.en-US: Locale pack. When omitted, undefined or null, the language of the outer LocaleProvider is inherited; without any outer provider, components fall back to zh_CN. The locale of ConfigProvider takes precedence over it. Takes the built-in zh_CN or en_US, or a custom pack with at least code, whose missing text and currency fall back to en_US.

children.en-US: Subtree that uses the locale pack.

componentName.zh-CN: 要读取的语言包命名空间，如 TimePicker；只接受 Locale 中声明的组件名，自定义命名空间通过 declaration merging 扩展 Locale。
componentName.en-US: Namespace of the locale pack to read, such as TimePicker. Only component names declared in Locale are accepted; extend Locale by declaration merging for custom namespaces.

children.zh-CN: 参数为 `{ locale, localeCode, currency }` 的 snippet，其中 locale 是 componentName 对应的文案片段。
children.en-US: Snippet receiving `{ locale, localeCode, currency }`, where locale is the text of componentName.
